rust.name: crates/domain/src/doctor.rs:496:47: replace > with >= in stalls
rust.why: A busy queue reports a stall at the exact combined hold and stall bound, which tests just before and after the cutoff would miss.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs:253:85: replace && with || in App::worker_hold
rust.why: An earlier hold by the same worker for a different resource can appear in the response if the test checks only that the new hold succeeded.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs:370:65: replace && with || in App::adopt_queued
rust.why: Adoption can claim another process's waiting entry, which a test containing only the current process's waiting entry would miss.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/heavy.rs:319:83: replace && with || in Queue::covered
rust.why: A worker's command can bypass a slot held by a different worker, while the shown negative case uses a command with no worker.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/load.rs:100:73: replace && with || in Load::granted
rust.why: A waiting entry's process tree can be treated as granted, which a load test using only started entries for one worker would miss.
